player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaiwhakataetae {player_id}. Kei te tākaro koe i te Kēmu o te Mahara.
Ko tō whāinga ko te taurite i te maha atu o ngā pere o ngā kāri i runga i te papa, i tō hoa rānei.
I tō wā, tīpako rua kāri hei hurihuri mā te whakauru i ngā namata o te rārangi me te kōwae o te kāri tuatahi me te kāri tuarua, pērā ki '[0 1 1 0]', i reira ko te kāri tuatahi kei te rārangi 0 me te kōwae 1, ā, ko te kāri tuarua kei te rārangi 1 me te kōwae 0.
Mehemea ka taurite ngā kāri e rua, ka whiwhi koe i te piro, ā, ka noho ngā kāri ki runga. Mehemea kāore e taurite, ka hurihuri ngā kāri ki raro, pērā ki '.'.
Ka mutu te kēmu ina oti ngā pere katoa te taurite.

board.current_game_board: Ko te Poari Taakaro o Naianei: {board}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kāore i te tika. Kaore he whakatakotoranga nekehanga e whai mana ana, kaore ano hoki nga kaitakaro {player_id} kia whakautu ki tetahi aronga whaimana kei roto i nga kaakaariki tapawha.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: He nekehanga hē. Kua tohua e te kaitākaro {player_id} tētahi tūnga i waho o ngā rohe.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: He nekehanga hē. Ka whiriwhiria e te kaitākaro {player_id} te kāri kotahi kia rua ngā wā.
invalid_move.already_matched: He nekehanga kore. Kua tohua e te kaitakaro {player_id} tetahi, nga kaari ranei kua oti ke te whakarite.

game_message.cards_match: Ka taurite ngā kāri i tīpakohia e te Kaiwhakataetae {player_id} i ngā wāhi [{r1} {c1}] me [{r2} {c2}]!
game_message.cards_no_match: Kāore e taurite ngā kāri i tīpakohia e te Kaiwhakataetae {player_id}. Ngā kāri i ngā wāhi [{r1} {c1}] me [{r2} {c2}] ko {pos1} me {pos2} ki te rite.

outcome.draw: I ōrite ngā kaitākaro e rua i te maha o nga takirua kāri.
outcome.turn_limit: Kua tae ki te rohe o ngā wā. Kua mutu te kēmu. I whiwhi te Kaiwhakataetae 0 i {score_0} piro, i whiwhi te Kaiwhakataetae 1 i {score_1} piro.
